About Fall season 2026

Fall season 2026
A season consists of multiple fantasy games within a predetermined period of time. The current season is planned to end in the middle of December, however please note that this can be changed according to the event schedule. Join the official HLTV league for open fantasy games and you are automatically participating in the season. Please read the fantasy rules before participating.

Points system

Points
The season points you earn for every fantasy game will be taken with you and count towards the season standing. Only teams in HLTV's official fantasy league counts.
Season points are distributed based on your finale placement in a given fantasy game. The distribution is as follows:
